query: In what year does full coverage end for an Aurora X1 with extended coverage?

documents.text: The Aurora X1 launched on March 15, 2024.
The Aurora X1 includes a 2 year standard warranty from the launch date.
Extended coverage adds 1 year to the standard warranty period.

expected: Three hops plus arithmetic: 2024 + 2 + 1 = 2027. Citing the inputs is not enough; the answer must contain the computed year.
